content: HMAC-SHA256 signed stateless tokens are the standard pattern for short-TTL nonce/anti-replay gates in serverless Node.js without a DB: sign a canonical payload (claims + exp) with a server secret, verify by recomputing HMAC and comparing via crypto.timingSafeEqual, TTL bounded to the tolerated window (commonly seconds-to-minutes). Fully stateless nonces cannot guarantee single-use (that requires a store like Redis SETNX+EX); accepting bounded replay within the TTL window is the standard tradeoff when avoiding new DB/Redis state.
